title: Thanks HN for 15 years of support and helping me find my life's work
summary: A founder reflects on 15 years since founding the Recurse Center (formerly Hacker School), sharing how HN helped them discover their life's work after a failed YC startup attempt with an 'OkCupid for jobs' idea that led to pivoting toward creating a self-directed programming retreat for developers.
problem_solved: This is not a technical solution but rather a personal narrative about building a programming community and finding purpose through entrepreneurship.
why_valuable: Provides an authentic, inspiring story about startup pivoting, community building, and the importance of creating spaces where programmers can learn and collaborate freely.
